verdict.rationale: Codex does expose API-driven paths — the CLI supports API-key auth (codex-gh-4), a JSON-RPC MCP server interface for programmatic control (codex-gh-6), and OpenAI's broader documented REST API with OpenAPI spec (codex-gh-9, codex-docs-29) — but the MCP server route is now marked deprecated (codex-docs-23) and community evidence notes the flagship Codex model isn't yet available via API ('gpt-5.3-codex isn't available on the API yet', codex-comm-5), indicating the documented API path is incomplete or in flux rather than a fully supported first-class interface.
